watches.name: Navajo 5 Stone Cuff Sterling Silver Signed Danny Henio
watches.description: Navajo Sterling Silver 5 Stone Turquoise Cuff Signed Danny Henio Handcrafted Navajo sterling silver cuff by Danny Henio, stamped “Danny Henio Sterling” on the interior. The bracelet features five substantial turquoise cabochons set in a traditional row design. Each stone is individually bezel-set with precise, balanced silverwork. The layout is clean and symmetrical, and the construction feels solid on the wrist without being bulky. The turquoise displays a rich blue-green tone with natural brown matrix. The cabochons are well cut and smoothly polished, allowing them to catch and reflect light across the surface. The bracelet weighs 44 grams, giving it a substantial, quality feel. Details: • Signed: Danny Henio Sterling • Navajo made • Solid sterling silver • Five natural turquoise stones • Weight: 44 grams • Classic row cuff design • 7” wearable size – slightly adjustable A strong example of traditional Navajo silversmithing with excellent stone presence and clean execution.

watches.name: Paramo Patagonia
watches.description: Bathed in the radiance of daylight, the Patagonia Blue Paramo unveils its unique allure. Its multifaceted dial, textured like glacial facets, glows with the icy blue of Patagonian glaciers. The Patagonia Blue Paramo – where the serenity of frozen landscapes meets timeless elegance. Includes 4 watch straps: BisonFlex Strap, Solid Diver’s Steel Bracelet, & Two Nylon Military Watch Straps Introducing BisonFlex: A tapered strap that exudes the American Bison’s resilience. With a vented design for optimal comfort, it’s constructed with hypoallergenic FKM rubber and finished with a brushed, marine-grade steel buckle. Its integrated endlink design fits the Paramo perfectly. Swiss-Made Quartz Movement Swiss Super-LumiNova luminous hands and indexes Brilliant rhodium-plated watch hands 200m (660 ft) Water Resistant Glass: Dual-curved sapphire crystal w/ interior anti-reflective coating (scratch-resistant) Designed in Austin, Texas by a family-owned and operated company Introducing the Paramo: Timeless Elegance Meets Uncompromising Durability Experience the Paramo by Wrist Hardware – a watch that marries the allure of vintage luxury sports watches with cutting-edge performance. Embrace a timepiece built for life’s adventures, both big and small, while making a statement of timeless elegance and dependability. The Paramo is more than just a watch; it’s a testament to craftsmanship and a passion for horology. Drawing inspiration from iconic 70s and 80s designs, the Paramo features a striking, tank-like case that exudes both beauty and resilience. Its sharp angles, alternating brushed and polished surfaces, and meticulously crafted lugs create a mesmerizing interplay of light that always captivates. Boasting 200m water resistance, this watch is designed for those who expect more from their wristwear. The Paramo’s versatile design complements a variety of strap styles and colors. Each purchase includes three premium straps for ultimate adaptability: Integrated Stainless Steel Bracelet: Classic Elegance and Comfort . The H-link bracelet is expertly crafted, flexible, and incredibly comfortable, making it the perfect choice for daily wear. The simple flip-lock and button-press clasp ensure a secure fit, while the 23mm to 18mm tapered bracelet adds a touch of heft to the overall design. Vintage-Style Rubber Strap: Retro Charm Meets Modern Performance . Experience the ideal blend of nostalgic appeal and contemporary functionality with this vintage-style rubber strap. The vented design is perfect for sports enthusiasts, preventing water or sweat from becoming trapped between the strap and the wearer’s skin. Crafted from high-quality fluoroelastomers (FKM), this strap offers exceptional durability, stain resistance, and comfort. The anti-corrosive, brushed 316L stainless steel buckle adds sophistication while ensuring lasting performance and reliability. Nylon Military Watch Strap: Rugged Endurance Meets Timeless Style . Discover luxurious comfort and unbeatable durability with our Nylon Military Watch Strap. Inspired by military tradition, this strap has been meticulously crafted to exceed mil-spec quality for enhanced robustness and longevity. Made from premium materials and precision manufacturing techniques, this watch strap is built to last. The Paramo’s dial is available in four captivating colorways: Obsidian, Polar, Patagonia Blue, and Emerald. Each dial highlights the intricate sector design, featuring a textured center and a sunburst effect on the raised track. Diamond-cut silvered hands and Super LumiNova BGW9-coated indices ensure outstanding legibility, while the small seconds sub-dial at six o’clock adds a hint of vintage opulence. A 2.6mm thick sapphire crystal glass with an interior anti-reflective coating offers unparalleled durability and clarity. Water-resistant up to 200 meters (660 feet), the Paramo is suitable for professional marine activities and demanding water sports. Driven by the reliable Ronda Slimte

watches.name: Mk. 1 Paramo
watches.description: Each MK1 case is carved out of a solid block of 316L stainless steel and is individually tested during quality control to a pressure of 30 ATM Swiss Super-LumiNova® luminescent coating on hands and hour markers for visibility in low light environments Removable, integrated H-Link Bracelet with double-locking diver’s clasp with three microadjustment positions 2.6mm thick, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with six layers of interior blue anti-reflective coating The perfect go-anywhere-do-anything sports watch is here. Built to thrive in any condition and exceed military spec, The Mk.1 Paramo is a tough sport watch that offers Swiss precision timekeeping. It is powered by the high accuracy Swiss made Ronda slimtech 1000 Calibre 1069. The inspiration for the Mk. 1 Paramo comes from the eponymous tundras unique to the high mountains of South America, home to exotic flora and fauna that have adapted to these harsh conditions. Every detail of this timepiece was designed with stringent requirements to produce a durable sport watch engineered to withstand the most adverse situations. The Mk.1 Paramo is a sport watch designed to excel in any environment. Its refined presence allows it to be dressed up or down easily. The comfortable slim case profile of the watch case features sharp angles with a combination of polished and brushed surfaces designed to play with light beautifully.
